title: History, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: RE-VERIFIED against the real archived 2025-2026 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/colleges/liberal-arts/history-ba/), fetched as raw HTML and cross-checked line-by-line against its own printed per-semester credit subtotals -- all 8 UP-specific-plan subtotals sum to exactly the page's own stated 'Total Credits 124', matching HIST-2026.json's own total exactly. IMPORTANT REAL STRUCTURAL FINDING: starting with the 2025-2026 edition, the bulletin splits the Suggested Academic Plan into TWO separate tables -- 'History, B.A. at University Park Campus' (this file's basis, since this app is University-Park-scoped; includes LA 83 and a required Second-Year seminar, total 124cr) and 'History, B.A. at Commonwealth Campuses' (no LA 83, total 122.5cr, not modeled here) -- the 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25 archived pages had only ONE combined plan for both. Direct raw-table extraction (verified via the HTML's own row/column headers, not WebFetch's summary) shows the University Park plan's LA 283-equivalent seminar actually sits in SECOND YEAR SPRING (paired with two 100/200-level HIST courses, 16.5cr that term), not Second Year Fall as HIST-2026.json's own notes claim -- and re-checking the CURRENT live bulletin page directly (not just this 2025-26 archive) confirms the live 2026-27 University Park plan places 'LA 283' in Second Year Spring too, identically to this 2025-26 archived page (byte-identical raw HTML table for that section). This means HIST-2026.json's own note describing LA 283 as 'named in the bulletin's own Second Year Fall semester' is factually incorrect (it is genuinely in Spring, confirmed independently against both this archive and the live page) -- flagging this as a pre-existing inaccuracy in HIST-2026.json for a separate pass to fix, since this agent's scope is limited to building 2022-2025 and the HIST-2026.json campus field only. This file's own Semester 4 (Second Year Spring) is built to match the real verified placement: the Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar slot together with the United States and Global field courses, while Semester 3 (Second Year Fall) carries only the Europe field course plus World Language Level 3 and Gen Eds -- this is a genuine, verified sequence difference from HIST-2026.json's own (differently-arranged, and in the LA 283 case factually wrong) Semester 3/4 split, not a copy-paste of it. As with the 2022-2024 files this batch, HIST 302W is kept separate from FOUR distinct 'HIST 400-level Course' slots plus the separately-required 3cr generic 100-400-level elective (36cr major total: 302W 3 + survey sequence 6 + fields 12 + generic 100-400 3 + 400-level 12 = 36) -- this real 400-level structure is unchanged from every other catalog year checked, and is modeled here more completely than HIST-2026.json's own admittedly-unreconciled 3-slot approximation. 'World Cultures' and 'World Language' terminology (post-rename, same as HIST-2026.json). Same field-category course-code lists as HIST-2026.json are reused here (Europe/US/Global/Pre-Modern) for the same handbook-sourcing reason and caveat noted in the other years' files. Entrance-to-major GPA (2.00) and third-semester classification requirement unchanged. 'At which campus can I study this program?' on this archived page: Begin Campus 'Any Penn State Campus', End Campus 'University Park, World Campus', with only Abington listed under 'Degree Information At Additional Campuses' -- no Erie/Behrend or Brandywine entry, matching the live 2026-27 page exactly (see HIST-2026.json campus finding: neither campus is in the bulletin's own campus list for this program in any year checked).
